title: Pork and Bigoli Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet meal featuring roasted pork and bigoli, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the roasted garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bigoli to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the italian seasoning to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Return the pork to the skillet and cook until heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
Season the pork and bigoli with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pork and bigoli hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
